title: AdvancedSurvival
description: AdvancedSurvival enhances your Minecraft survival server with a comprehensive skill system, custom enchantments, a backpack, homes, RTP, and many other features.
body:
# ⚔️ AdvancedSurvival

> The ultimate survival expansion pack for PaperMC 1.21+
> Skills, custom enchantments, backpack, homes, RTP, stash, and much more.

---

## ✨ Features

✔ 11 unique skills with a leveling system  
✔ Custom enchantments via the anvil  
✔ Multi-slot backpack  
✔ Expanded Ender Chest  
✔ Home system & waypoints  
✔ Random Teleport (RTP)  
✔ Automatic overflow stash  
✔ Fully configurable  
✔ Modern GUI systems  
✔ Persistent player data  
✔ PaperMC 1.21.11 support  

---

## 🏆 Skill System

Players can earn XP and level up their skills.

### Available Skills

* ⛏ Mining
* 🪵 Logging
* 🔥 Smelting
* 💀 Spawner
* 🌱 Farming
* 👁 Ender
* 🎒 Backpack
* 🧭 Travel
* 🏊 Swimming
* ⚔ Combat
* 🫧 Diving

Each skill has:

* 10 levels
* unique rewards
* customizable XP values
* unlockable features

---

## ⚗️ Custom Enchants

## Included Enchants

### 🪓 TreeCapitator

Fells entire trees at once.

### ⛏ OreMiner

Automatically mines entire ore veins.

### ⚗ AutoSmelt

Ores are smelted immediately.

### 🏠 SpawnerBreaker

Spawners can be picked up.

### 🌱 Replanting

Automatically harvests and replants.

### 🌱 Soil Protector

Farmland cannot be trampled.

### 🌊 Swift Swim

Swim faster with Dolphin's Grace.

### 🌙 Night Vision

Permanent night vision.

### 🫧 Aqua Breather

Infinite water breathing.

---

## 🎒 Backpack System

* Multi-page backpack
* Unlocked via skills
* Persistently saved
* Up to 11 pages

Command:

```bash id="i1"
 /backpack
```

---

## 🌌 Ender Chest+

Enhanced Ender Chest with multiple pages.

Command:

```bash id="i2"
 /enderchest
```

---

## 📦 Stash System

Automatic overflow stash when inventories are full.

Command:

```bash id="i3"
 /stash
```

---

## 🏠 Homes & Waypoints

Players can:

* Set homes
* Create waypoints
* Teleport
* Unlock travel

Commands:

```bash id="i4"
/sethome
/home
/addpoint
/goto
```

---

## 🌍 RTP System

Safe random teleport with:

* Warmup
* Cooldown
* Movement cancellation

Command:

```bash id="i5"
/rtp
```

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable

All features can be customized:

* XP values
* Messages
* Skill levels
* Cooldowns
* Feature activation
* Enchantments
* GUI texts

Files:

```bash id="i6"
settings.yml
messages.yml
skills.yml
```

---

## 📜 Commands

### Players

```bash id="i7"
/skills
/backpack
/enderchest
/stash
/sethome
/home
/homes
/rtp
```

## Admins

```bash id="i8"
/treecapitator
/oreminer
/autosmelt
/spawnerbreaker
/replanting
/nightvision
```

---

## ✅ Requirements

| Software | Version |
| -------- | ------- |
| PaperMC  | 1.21.11   |
| Java     | JDK 21+ |

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the JAR file
2. Place it in the `plugins/` folder
3. Start the server
4. Adjust the configuration
5. Done
